title: Panduan Awal Mengimpor Barang ke Indonesia
keywords: how to import goods into indonesia
answer: Untuk memulai impor ke Indonesia, susun checklist berikut: (1) lengkapi deskripsi barang dan pastikan klasifikasi HS; (2) cek tarif, larangan/pembatasan, dan izin yang mungkin diperlukan melalui INSW serta konfirmasi kepada Bea Cukai atau instansi terkait; (3) pastikan legalitas dan akses kepabeanan usaha sesuai jenis barang; (4) sepakati pemasok, Incoterm, mata uang, jumlah, dan jadwal; (5) siapkan commercial invoice, packing list, Bill of Lading atau Air Waybill, serta Certificate of Origin atau sertifikat lain bila diwajibkan; dan (6) proses PIB serta pembayaran kewajiban melalui prosedur resmi. Persyaratan dan bea/pajak bergantung pada klasifikasi, asal, dan aturan terbaru, jadi jangan gunakan estimasi AI sebagai penetapan resmi.
answerEn: To start importing goods into Indonesia, prepare this checklist: (1) provide a complete goods description and confirm the HS classification; (2) check tariffs, restrictions, and any required permits through INSW and confirm with Customs or the relevant authority; (3) ensure the business has the appropriate legality and customs access for the goods; (4) agree on the supplier, Incoterm, currency, quantity, and schedule; (5) prepare the commercial invoice, packing list, Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, and a Certificate of Origin or other certificates if required; and (6) process the import declaration (PIB) and applicable payments through official procedures. Requirements and duties/taxes depend on classification, origin, and current rules, so do not treat an AI estimate as an official determination.

title: Perbedaan FOB dan CIF
answer: FOB (Free On Board) berarti penjual menyerahkan barang di atas kapal pada pelabuhan muat yang disepakati; setelah itu risiko berpindah kepada pembeli. CIF (Cost, Insurance, Freight) berarti penjual juga menanggung biaya angkut dan asuransi minimum sampai pelabuhan tujuan, tetapi risiko tetap berpindah saat barang dimuat di kapal. Keduanya diatur dalam Incoterms 2020; pilih sesuai kontrak dan kemampuan menanggung biaya serta risiko.
answerEn: FOB (Free On Board) means the seller delivers the goods on board at the agreed port of shipment; after that, risk passes to the buyer. CIF (Cost, Insurance, Freight) means the seller also pays freight and minimum insurance to the destination port, but risk still passes once the goods are on board. Both are defined in Incoterms 2020; choose according to the contract and your ability to bear costs and risks.

title: Apa Itu Incoterms
answer: Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) adalah aturan standar dari ICC yang menjelaskan pembagian biaya, risiko, dan kewajiban antara penjual dan pembeli dalam perdagangan internasional. Versi terbaru adalah Incoterms 2020 dengan 11 aturan, termasuk EXW, FOB, CIF, dan DDP. Pilih aturan yang sesuai dengan moda transportasi dan kesepakatan kontrak.
answerEn: Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) are ICC standard rules that define how costs, risks, and obligations are divided between seller and buyer in international trade. The current version is Incoterms 2020 with 11 rules, including EXW, FOB, CIF, and DDP. Choose the rule that fits the transport mode and the contract.

title: Cara Kerja Escrow Vault

answer: Escrow adalah mekanisme penitipan dana pada pihak ketiga yang dicairkan bertahap setelah syarat tertentu terpenuhi. Untuk transaksi nyata, gunakan penyedia escrow atau pembayaran resmi dan periksa kontrak secara mandiri.
answerEn: Escrow is a mechanism where funds are held by a third party and released in stages once conditions are met. The NusaBridge Escrow Vault is a four-stage simulation (down payment, PEB/Bill of Lading, customs clearance, and delivery) that explains the flow; it does not process real payments. title: NIB dan Legalitas Usaha
answer: NIB (Nomor Induk Berusaha) adalah identitas pelaku usaha yang diterbitkan melalui sistem OSS. NIB menjadi dasar legalitas usaha dan pengurusan izin lain, termasuk kegiatan ekspor. Pastikan data usaha dan NPWP benar saat mendaftar di oss.go.id.
answerEn: The NIB (Nomor Induk Berusaha) is the business identity number issued through the OSS system. It is the basis for business legality and other permits, including export activities. Make sure your business details and tax ID are correct when registering at oss.go.id.

title: Kode HS dan Tarif
answer: Kode HS (Harmonized System) adalah klasifikasi barang yang digunakan untuk menentukan tarif bea masuk dan persyaratan perdagangan. Cek kode HS produk melalui INSW atau konsultasi dengan Bea Cukai; kesalahan klasifikasi dapat menyebabkan tarif atau dokumen yang salah. Sertakan deskripsi barang yang lengkap saat meminta penetapan.
answerEn: The HS code (Harmonized System) classifies goods for customs duties and trade requirements. Check your product's HS code through INSW or consult Customs; a wrong classification can lead to incorrect duties or documents. Provide a complete product description when requesting a ruling.

title: Metode Pembayaran Ekspor
answer: Metode pembayaran ekspor yang umum meliputi T/T (transfer bank), L/C (Letter of Credit), dan documentary collection. Pilih metode berdasarkan nilai transaksi, tingkat kepercayaan, dan risiko negara; L/C memberi jaminan bank tetapi biayanya lebih tinggi. Pastikan rekening dan identitas buyer terverifikasi sebelum mengirim barang.
answerEn: Common export payment methods include T/T (bank transfer), L/C (Letter of Credit), and documentary collection. Choose based on transaction value, trust, and country risk; an L/C provides a bank guarantee but costs more. Verify the buyer's identity and bank account before shipping.

title: Pengiriman dan Ongkos Kirim
answer: Pengiriman ekspor dapat menggunakan laut (FCL/LCL), udara, atau darat. Biaya dan jadwal dipengaruhi oleh rute, volume, berat, dan Incoterms. Minta penawaran dari freight forwarder resmi, pastikan jadwal kapal, dan cocokkan dokumen pengiriman dengan PEB serta Bill of Lading.
answerEn: Export shipments can use sea (FCL/LCL), air, or land transport. Costs and schedules depend on the route, volume, weight, and Incoterm. Request quotes from authorized freight forwarders, confirm vessel schedules, and match shipping documents with the PEB and Bill of Lading.

answer: Certificate of Origin (COO) menerangkan asal barang dan sering diperlukan untuk tarif preferensi atau aturan impor negara tujuan. title: Bea Cukai dan PEB
answer: Bea Cukai mengelola kepabeanan, termasuk PEB untuk ekspor dan PIB untuk impor. PEB diajukan melalui sistem kepabeanan sebelum barang dimuat, dan datanya harus sesuai invoice, packing list, serta Bill of Lading. Periksa prosedur terbaru di beacukai.go.id atau INSW.
answerEn: Customs (Bea Cukai) manages import and export procedures, including the PEB for exports and PIB for imports. The PEB is submitted through the customs system before cargo is loaded, and its data must match the invoice, packing list, and Bill of Lading. Check the latest procedures at beacukai.go.id or INSW.

title: Commercial Invoice dan Packing List
answer: Commercial invoice memuat identitas penjual dan pembeli, deskripsi barang, jumlah, harga, Incoterms, dan negara asal. Packing list merinci kemasan, berat, dan dimensi. Keduanya harus konsisten dengan PEB dan dokumen pengiriman; perbedaan data dapat menunda proses kepabeanan.
answerEn: A commercial invoice contains the seller and buyer details, goods description, quantity, price, Incoterm, and country of origin. A packing list details packaging, weight, and dimensions. title: Asuransi Pengiriman
answer: Asuransi pengiriman melindungi barang dari risiko selama transportasi. Pada CIF, penjual wajib menutup asuransi minimum untuk pembeli; pada FOB, umumnya pembeli yang mengasuransikan. Pilih pertanggungan sesuai nilai barang dan rute, lalu simpan polis untuk keperluan klaim.
answerEn: Cargo insurance protects goods against risks during transport. Under CIF, the seller must arrange minimum insurance for the buyer; under FOB, the buyer usually insures the goods. Choose coverage based on cargo value and route, and keep the policy for claims.

title: Memilih Negara Tujuan Ekspor
answer: Pemilihan negara tujuan mempertimbangkan permintaan produk, tarif, regulasi, jarak logistik, dan daya saing harga. Gunakan data ekspor dan informasi pasar dari Kemendag atau perwakilan dagang, lalu verifikasi persyaratan impor negara tersebut. Mulai dari pasar yang regulasinya sederhana dan permintaannya stabil.
answerEn: Choosing a destination considers product demand, tariffs, regulations, logistics distance, and price competitiveness. Use export data and market information from the Ministry of Trade or trade representatives, then verify the destination's import requirements. Start with markets that have simpler regulations and stable demand.

answer: NusaBridge adalah website informasi dan simulasi perdagangan ekspor-impor untuk UMKM Indonesia. Website ini menggabungkan katalog 50 produk, chat NusaBridge AI, studio Solusi AI (RFQ Studio, draf Auto-PDF, simulasi KYC Hub, dan simulasi Escrow Vault), serta halaman Harga. It combines a 50-product catalog, NusaBridge AI chat, an AI Solutions studio (RFQ Studio, Auto-PDF drafts, KYC Hub simulation, and Escrow Vault simulation), and a Pricing page. NusaBridge is a platform, not a seller, producer, bank, or official verification authority. Main pages: Home, Products, AI Solutions, and Pricing, plus a Login/Register modal for exporter or importer accounts.

title: Fitur Website NusaBridge
answer: Fitur utama website NusaBridge: (1) katalog 50 produk dengan pencarian, filter kategori, sortir, halaman 12 produk, modal spesifikasi, dan formulir RFQ; (2) chat NusaBridge AI untuk menjelaskan website dan panduan umum ekspor-impor; (3) studio Solusi AI berisi RFQ Studio, draf Auto-PDF, simulasi KYC Hub, dan simulasi Escrow Vault; (4) akun eksportir/importir dengan profil usaha dan logo; serta (5) halaman Harga dengan informasi paket, voucher, dan kalkulator estimasi. Auto-PDF, KYC Hub, dan Escrow Vault adalah draf atau simulasi, bukan layanan resmi.
answerEn: Main NusaBridge features: (1) a 50-product catalog with search, category filters, sorting, 12 products per page, a specification modal, and an RFQ form; (2) NusaBridge AI chat for website and general export-import guidance; (3) an AI Solutions studio with RFQ Studio, Auto-PDF drafts, KYC Hub simulation, and Escrow Vault simulation; (4) exporter/importer accounts with a business profile and logo; and (5) a Pricing page with plan information, a voucher, and an estimate calculator. Auto-PDF, KYC Hub, and Escrow Vault are drafts or simulations, not official services.

title: Peran Akun: Eksportir dan Importir
answer: NusaBridge memiliki dua peran akun. Eksportir (seller) untuk pelaku usaha Indonesia: fokus pada profil usaha, informasi produk, alur RFQ, draf dokumen, data KYC, dan simulasi Escrow. Importir (buyer) untuk pembeli luar negeri: fokus pada katalog, spesifikasi produk, pengajuan RFQ, Incoterms dan dokumen, serta simulasi Escrow. Peran memengaruhi panduan dan konteks jawaban AI, tetapi tidak membuka dashboard transaksi, unggah produk, atau ruang negosiasi terpisah.
answerEn: NusaBridge has two account roles. Exporter (seller) for Indonesian businesses: focuses on the business profile, product information, RFQ flow, document drafts, KYC data, and the Escrow simulation. Importer (buyer) for overseas buyers: focuses on the catalog, product specifications, RFQ submission, Incoterms and documents, and the Escrow simulation. The role changes guidance and AI context, but it does not unlock a transaction dashboard, product upload, or a separate negotiation room.

title: Daftar dan Masuk Akun NusaBridge
answer: Untuk membuat akun, klik Daftar di navigation bar. Pilih peran Eksportir (seller) atau Importir (buyer), isi nama usaha dan email, unggah logo bila perlu, lalu klik Lanjutkan. title: Alur RFQ di Website NusaBridge
keywords: how do i submit an rfq
answer: Alur RFQ di NusaBridge: buka halaman Produk, pilih produk, lalu klik Ajukan RFQ. Produk sudah terpilih; isi jumlah, pilih Incoterms (FOB, CIF, CNF, atau EXW), pelabuhan tujuan, dan email kontak, lalu klik Kirim RFQ. Jika tersimpan, website menampilkan nomor RFQ, detail permintaan, status Diajukan — menunggu peninjauan, dan tahapan proses. Tombol Perbarui Status mengambil status terbaru untuk nomor tersebut. Bukti RFQ bukan bukti pembayaran atau pesanan yang sudah disepakati; website tidak otomatis mengirim RFQ ke pemasok, menerima atau membandingkan penawaran, atau menyediakan dashboard negosiasi.
answerEn: NusaBridge RFQ flow: open the Products page, choose a product, then click Submit RFQ. The product is preselected; enter the quantity, choose Incoterms (FOB, CIF, CNF, or EXW), the destination port, and a contact email, then click Send RFQ. If saved, the site shows the RFQ number, request details, the status Submitted — awaiting review, and process steps. Refresh Status fetches the latest status for that number. An RFQ receipt is not proof of payment or a confirmed order; the site does not automatically send the RFQ to a supplier, collect or compare quotations, or provide a negotiation dashboard.

title: Kegunaan & Fitur Khusus Eksportir Indonesia (Seller)
answer: Kegunaan dan fitur untuk akun Eksportir (Seller) di NusaBridge: (1) Menyiapkan profil usaha dan menampilkan komoditas ekspor; (2) Memvalidasi NIB 13 digit OSS RBA dan NPWP di KYC Hub untuk lencana Verified Global Exporter Shield; (3) Menerima dan menganalisis permintaan RFQ dari buyer luar negeri dengan kalkulasi margin aman Incoterms 2020; (4) Menerbitkan draf dokumen ekspor (Proforma Invoice, Sales Contract, draft PEB) di Auto-PDF Generator; serta (5) Memantau simulasi pencairan 4 fase di Escrow Vault (30% DP, 30% PEB/stuffing, 20% B/L, 20% tiba) untuk mencegah risiko gagal bayar.
answerEn: Features and usage for Exporter (Seller) accounts on NusaBridge: (1) Prepare business profile and showcase export commodities; (2) Validate 13-digit NIB OSS RBA and NPWP in KYC Hub to earn the Verified Global Exporter Shield; (3) Review and calculate buyer RFQs with Incoterms safe margins; (4) Generate draft export documents (Proforma Invoice, Sales Contract, PEB) via Auto-PDF Generator; and (5) Monitor the 4-phase Escrow Vault payout simulation (30% DP, 30% PEB, 20% B/L, 20% arrival) to mitigate non-payment risks.

title: Kegunaan & Fitur Khusus Importir Global (Buyer)
answer: Kegunaan dan fitur untuk akun Importir (Buyer) di NusaBridge: (1) Menjelajah 50 komoditas ekspor unggulan Indonesia dengan parameter mutu lab dan HS Code; (2) Mengajukan RFQ instan dengan Incoterms pilihan (FOB/CIF/CNF/EXW) dan pelabuhan tujuan; (3) Memeriksa checklist regulasi negara tujuan di KYC Hub (FDA USA, EUDR Uni Eropa, JAS Jepang, Halal UEA); (4) Meninjau draf Sales Contract berstandar ICC 2020; (5) Mengamankan pembayaran di simulasi Escrow Vault multi-valas (dana terlindungi hingga kargo lolos verifikasi); serta (6) Melacak posisi kapal kargo maritim secara real-time melalui telemetri AIS.
answerEn: Features and usage for Importer (Buyer) accounts on NusaBridge: (1) Browse 50 curated Indonesian export commodities with lab specs and HS codes; (2) Submit structured RFQs with chosen Incoterms (FOB/CIF/CNF/EXW) and destination ports; (3) Check destination compliance in KYC Hub (US FDA, EU EUDR, Japan JAS, UAE Halal); (4) Review draft ICC 2020 Sales Contracts; (5) Secure payments via the multi-currency Escrow Vault simulation; and (6) Track cargo vessels via real-time AIS maritime radar telemetries.

title: Panduan Ekspor ke Jerman & Uni Eropa
answer: Untuk mengekspor komoditas (terutama kopi, rempah, kayu/rotan) ke Jerman dan Uni Eropa: (1) Penuhi aturan EUDR (European Union Deforestation Regulation) dengan bukti koordinat kebun bebas deforestasi dan nomor Due Diligence Statement (DDS) TRACES NT; (2) Uji laboratorium bebas residu pestisida terlarang dan kadar mikotoksin/aflatoksin; (3) Siapkan dokumen ekspor: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Ocean Bill of Lading, dan COO Form A / REX System untuk tarif preferensi GSP+; (4) Sepakati Incoterms (biasanya CIF Hamburg atau FOB Pelabuhan Belawan/Priok); (5) Gunakan simulasi KYC Hub di NusaBridge untuk memeriksa checklist lengkap standar Uni Eropa.
answerEn: To export commodities (especially coffee, spices, wood/rattan) to Germany and the EU: (1) Comply with EUDR regulations with deforestation-free geolocations and TRACES NT Due Diligence Statements; (2) Pass lab testing for pesticide residues and mycotoxins; (3) Prepare export documents: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, B/L, and COO (REX System / Form A) for GSP+ tariff benefits; (4) Agree on Incoterms (CIF Hamburg or FOB Belawan/Priok); (5) Use the KYC Hub simulation on NusaBridge to review the complete EU checklist.

title: Panduan Ekspor ke Amerika Serikat
answer: Untuk mengekspor komoditas ke Amerika Serikat: (1) Daftarkan fasilitas pangan ke US FDA (Food Facility Registration); (2) Lengkapi FDA Prior Notice sebelum kapal kargo tiba di pelabuhan tujuan (seperti Port of Los Angeles atau New York); (3) Pastikan kebersihan rempah/kopi memenuhi standar ASTA dan US FSVP; (4) Untuk produk rotan/kayu, wajib memiliki sertifikasi SVLK V-Legal dan perlakuan fumigasi ISPM 15; (5) Siapkan Invoice, Packing List, dan Ocean Bill of Lading. Anda dapat menguji kepatuhan standar FDA pada simulasi KYC Hub di halaman Solusi AI NusaBridge.
answerEn: To export commodities to the United States: (1) Register your food facility with the US FDA; (2) File an FDA Prior Notice before arrival at the destination port (e.g. Los Angeles or New York); (3) Ensure spices/coffee meet ASTA cleanliness and FSVP rules; (4) Wood/rattan products require V-Legal SVLK and ISPM 15 fumigation; (5) Prepare Invoice, Packing List, and B/L. Test FDA compliance using the KYC Hub simulation on NusaBridge AI Solutions.

title: Panduan Ekspor ke Jepang
answer: Untuk mengekspor komoditas ke Jepang: (1) Pastikan produk mematuhi Positive List System MHLW Jepang (batas residu bahan kimia dan pestisida); (2) Untuk komoditas organik, miliki sertifikasi JAS (Japanese Agricultural Standard); (3) Manfaatkan COO Form IJEPA (Indonesia-Japan Economic Partnership) untuk tarif bea masuk 0%; (4) Pastikan inspeksi karantina tumbuhan bebas serangga hidup; (5) Siapkan dokumen Commercial Invoice, Packing List, dan Bill of Lading ke pelabuhan Tokyo, Yokohama, atau Kobe.
answerEn: To export commodities to Japan: (1) Ensure compliance with the MHLW Positive List System for pesticide residues; (2) Organic goods require JAS (Japanese Agricultural Standard) certification; (3) Use COO Form IJEPA for 0% duty tariffs under the trade agreement; (4) Ensure quarantine clearance for live pests; (5) Prepare Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and B/L to Tokyo, Yokohama, or Kobe ports.

title: Radar Maritim AIS & Pelacakan Kontainer
answer: Fitur Radar Maritim NusaBridge menampilkan pelacakan langsung kapal kargo ekspor-impor menggunakan telemetri AIS (Automatic Identification System). Pengguna dapat melihat nama kapal (seperti KM Baruna Nusantara rute Priok-Hamburg, MV Samudera Raya rute Perak-LA, KM Celebes Express rute Belawan-Tokyo), koordinat laut, kecepatan berlayar dalam knots, persentase progres, dan estimasi waktu tiba (ETA). Terkoneksi dengan pemantauan Escrow Vault saat Bill of Lading (B/L) on-board telah terbit.
answerEn: The NusaBridge Maritime Radar displays live tracking of export-import cargo vessels using AIS (Automatic Identification System) telemetries. Users can observe vessel names (KM Baruna Nusantara, MV Samudera Raya, KM Celebes Express), trans-oceanic routes, nautical coordinates, speed in knots, progress percentage, and ETA. It integrates with Escrow Vault milestones once on-board B/L documents are verified.
